decisions.reason: Approval of the listed blog topics does not approve or change the separately selected blog keywords.
The source approves topic selections, not completed articles for publication, and does not alter the publication prerequisites.
Topic approval does not change the required article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
Approval of blog topics does not change the specified Gen Z audience for the AI dolls blog.
Topic approval does not modify the word-count target for blog content.
Topic approval does not change any image count, relevance, placement, coverage, or publication condition.
Topic approval does not change internal-link inclusion, destinations, applicability, or publication prerequisites.
The approval concerns proposed blog topics and does not modify the scope or contents of the SEO plan deliverable.
Approval of blog topics does not approve or alter the keyword research report, its keyword replacements, or its search-volume requirement.
